Run after 3.1. Volcano and protein UpSet plots use saved results and thresholds; no model is refitted.

```{r setup}
source("CoPPRA_config_SEA.R", local = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ComplexUpset)
```


# Read saved limma results



```{r read_limma}
paths_SEA <- stage_paths_SEA("Limma")
plot_folder_SEA <- paths_SEA$plots
list2env(read_data_SEA(file.path(paths_SEA$data, "Limma_results_SEA.rds")), envir = environment())
```

# Peptide volcano plots



```{r peptide_volcano, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
volcano_data_SEA <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  peptide_significance_SEA %>%
    dplyr::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Sequence,
      log2FC = Ru_log2FC,
      p_value = Ru_vs_Control_pvalue,
      Comparison = "Ru vs Control"
    ),
  peptide_significance_SEA %>%
    dplyr::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Sequence,
      log2FC = Ul_log2FC,
      p_value = Ul_vs_Control_pvalue,
      Comparison = "Ul vs Control"
    ),
  peptide_significance_SEA %>%
    dplyr::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Sequence,
      log2FC = RU_log2FC,
      p_value = RU_vs_Control_pvalue,
      Comparison = "RU vs Control"
    )
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Comparison = factor(
      Comparison,
      levels = c("Ru vs Control", "Ul vs Control", "RU vs Control")
    ),
    neg_log10_p = -log10(
      pmax(p_value, .Machine$double.xmin)
    ),
    Peptide_call = dplyr::case_when(
      p_value < pval_threshold_SEA &
        log2FC > log2fc_threshold_SEA ~ "Higher in treatment",
      p_value < pval_threshold_SEA &
        log2FC < -log2fc_threshold_SEA ~ "Higher in Control",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

p_volcano_SEA <- ggplot(
  volcano_data_SEA,
  aes(log2FC, neg_log10_p, color = Peptide_call)
) +
  geom_point(size = 1.4, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(pval_threshold_SEA),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(-log2fc_threshold_SEA, log2fc_threshold_SEA),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Comparison, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey75",
      "Higher in Control" = "#1F77B4",
      "Higher in treatment" = "#D62728"
    ),
    name = "Peptide call"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "log2(Fold Change)",
    y = "-log10(P value)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  )

print(p_volcano_SEA)

save_plot_SEA(p_volcano_SEA, "peptide_volcano_significant", 18, 6)
```

# Protein intersections



```{r protein_upset, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
if (nrow(protein_significance_SEA) == 0L) {
  cat("No significant proteins; no UpSet intersections to draw.\n")
} else {
protein_upset_data_SEA <- protein_significance_SEA %>%
  dplyr::select(ProteinID, Ru_sig, RU_sig, Ul_sig)

colnames(protein_upset_data_SEA) <- c("ProteinID", "R", "RU", "U")

upset_theme_SEA <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_upset_SEA <- upset(
  protein_upset_data_SEA,
  c("R", "U", "RU"),
  name = "Significant proteins",
  encode_sets = FALSE,
  base_annotations = list(
    "Protein Numbers" = intersection_size(
      text = list(size = 6)
    ) +
      labs(y = "Protein Numbers") +
      upset_theme_SEA
  ),
  width_ratio = 0.1,
  min_size = 1,
  themes = upset_theme_SEA
) +
  ggtitle("Conjunctional targeting") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold")
  )

print(p_upset_SEA)

save_plot_SEA(p_upset_SEA, "significant_protein_upset", 10, 6)
}
```
